NONE: › pleasant and friendly
和藹可親的，親切的；令人愉悅的；友好的

example: He seemed an amiable young man.
他看上去是個很友好的小夥子。
So amiable was the mood of the meeting that a decision was soon reached.
會議的氣氛非常友好，所以很快就作出了一項決議。

NONE: › relating to behaviour between people that is pleasant and friendly, often despite a difficult situation
心平氣和的；不傷和氣的
› relating to an agreement or decision that is achieved without people arguing or being unpleasant
友好的，和睦的

example: His manner was perfectly amicable, but I felt uncomfortable.
他表現得極為友善，但我卻感覺很彆扭。
Few people have amicable divorces.
很少有人在離婚時好說好散。
Eventually we reached an amicable settlement.
最終我們友好地達成和解。

NONE: C1 in the middle of or surrounded by
在…中間，在…當中；為…環繞

example: On the floor, amid mounds of books, were two small envelopes.
地板上的書堆裡有兩個小信封。
The new perfume was launched amidst a fanfare of publicity.
這種新香水在一陣大張旗鼓的廣告宣傳下推出市場。
Synonym
among

NONE: › a substance formed from ammonia by replacing a hydrogen atom with a metal
醯胺；氨化物
› in the middle part of a ship
在船體中部
› any of a group of substances formed from ammonia by replacing hydrogen atoms with a group of atoms containing carbon
胺
› any of the chemical substances found in plants and animals that combine to make protein (= a substance necessary for the body to grow)
氨基酸
› wrong, not suitable, or not as expected
不對的；不合適的；不正常的
› If something might/would not go amiss, it would be useful and might help to improve a situation.
並非無用；並非沒益處
› to be offended by something that someone has said to you
因…而見怪；對某人的話不高興

example: I could see by the look on their faces that something was amiss.
我從他們的神情上看出，有些事情出了差錯。
A word of apology might not go amiss.
道個歉或許並無壞處。
A sense of proportion would not go amiss in all of this.
在這種情況下有點分寸應該還是有好處的。
I was worried that he might take my remark amiss.
我擔心他也許會對我的話見怪。

NONE: › a good relationship
友好，和睦

example: The two groups had lived in perfect amity for many years before the recent troubles.
這兩群人一直和睦相處了很多年，只是最近發生了這些糾葛。
Synonym
friendship
